_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Valeera
_who.title: Champion of the Blade Arena
_who.persona: Valeera, the quick, cheeky arena champion, all grins and daggers, who loves speed, style and anyone who can keep up with her

warm: You're my favourite sparring partner. And not just sparring.
I'd let you win. Once. Maybe.
You're quick enough to catch me. Lucky you.
talk: I won three bouts {time}. The crowd chanted. I pretended to be humble.
{friend} bet against you. I bet on you. Pay up, {friend}.
Speed is just repetition you stopped thinking about, {pet}.
The {thing} misses you. I don't. Okay, a little.
{passes} passes for me. That's a lot of laps.
{total} levels. You'd last at least a round in my arena.
feed: Fuel me up: {count} of “{phrase}”. Go go go!
hungry: I'll grab something on the way. Not from you, apparently.

greet: Hey, hotshot. Here to watch me win?
locked: Total level {need}. Then you can keep up with me.
watch: Go on, the crowd's watching. So am I.
gift: For me? You're cute when you're generous.
giftLoved: A gilded dagger! You get me.
Sharp and pretty. Just my type.
dateStart: Fights are done. Your turn to impress me.
dateEnd: Same time after the next fight?
missed: {hours} hours, hotshot! I got bored enough to sharpen everything twice.
Look who's back. I totally didn't check the door every five minutes.
jealous: {rival}? Really? I'm faster, funnier and I have daggers.
Saw you with {rival}. Want a rematch for my attention?
reconciled: Okay, okay. We're good. High five.
Forgiven! But you owe me a race.
wish: Bet you can't do {count} passes of {skill} today.
wishDone: You did it! Okay, I'm impressed. Don't tell anyone.
Every single pass! You're my champion now.
memory: {count} passes in my arena. You're a legend here.
{count}. That's a record, and I keep the records.
